name: workflow_install
title: Install workflow template
description: Write a GitHub Actions workflow template of pecot into the repository

name.description: Name of the workflow template (board-sync, review, handoff, auto, github-ops)

check.description: Write nothing; check that the file in the repository has the version of the bundled template

force.description: Overwrite the file when it already exists

directory.description: Root of the target Git repository (absolute or relative path; default: the current directory)

path.description: Path of the workflow file from the repository root

installedVersion.description: Version of the file already in the repository; omitted when there is no file or no version marker

written.description: Whether the file was written (false on check)

upToDate.description: With check: whether the file in the repository has the version of the bundled template

removedLines.description: With force: lines you added between the begin and end markers, which the bundled template replaces

detail.description: Full failure text: the error message and the guidance lines that follow it (failure only)

log.description: Raw output of a child process (failure only; omitted when not captured)

warnings.description: Warning messages; continuation lines of a message are indented by two spaces (omitted when there is none)
